metadata.title: Gale crater region / MOLA MEGDR 64 ppd
metadata.projection: local equirectangular tangent approximation, R=3396000m, cos(center latitude) longitude correction
metadata.processing: Exact 65 by 65 crop of native 64 ppd signed big-endian int16 samples. No resampling, smoothing, stretching or filling.
metadata.caveat: Native grid spacing is not effective resolving power. The original product includes interpolated empty bins and equatorial track gaps up to 12km. Not rover navigation ground truth.
metadata.credit: NASA / MGS MOLA Science Team / Goddard Space Flight Center; NASA PDS Geosciences Node
